notes: This contract pins the bounded Auto Provide behavior in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. The composed FDD seeds one federation-wide dynamic value, omitted input is Disabled, the standard HLAsetSwitches MOM interaction can change that value during execution using the official HLAswitch encoding, and an enabled value causes the RTI to solicit current owners of newly discovered in-scope attributes through Provide Attribute Value Update with an empty tag. Other MOM switches, complete multi-owner/regional/update-rate behavior, package evidence, protected review, JUnit promotion, and conformance remain open.
